changes.zh: 更新 Switch、Switch 2、PS5 與 Xbox、Windows 部分畫面上的遊戲圖示。
changes.en: Updated the game icon on Switch, Switch 2 and PS5, and in some places on Xbox and Windows.

changes.zh: 修正多種遊戲中的當機。
修正同機合作時從主世界回到主選單會卡住，第二位玩家可能在建立或選擇英雄時被踢出。
changes.en: Fixed a hard lock in couch co-op when returning to the main menu from the Overworld, which could kick the second player while creating or picking a hero.

changes.zh: 改善錯誤代碼「CH1」相關的登入穩定性。
changes.en: Improved login stability around error code "CH1".

changes.zh: 修正快速連續使用後神器欄位無法使用（MCD2-135）。
changes.en: Fixed artifact slots becoming unusable after rapid repeated use (MCD2-135).

changes.zh: 修正離開再重新加入後，至高附魔師的競技場維持降下而卡住進度（MCD2-67）。
changes.en: Fixed The Prime Enchanter's arena staying lowered after leaving and rejoining, which blocked progress (MCD2-67).

changes.zh: 修正「伏聆者之怒」的任務標記指向錯誤位置。
changes.en: Fixed quest markers pointing to the wrong places in "Wrath of the Sculkers".

changes.zh: 修正「附魔匠的訓練」的任務標記（MCD2-23）。
changes.en: Fixed the quest marker for "Training with the Enchantsmith" (MCD2-23).

changes.zh: 修正線上遊戲時任務日誌顯示過多玩家圖示。
changes.en: Fixed the quest journal showing too many player icons in online games.

changes.zh: 修正 Switch 與 Switch 2 上無法開啟豪華版商店頁面。
changes.en: Fixed the Deluxe Edition store page not opening on Switch and Switch 2.

changes.zh: 修正多種遊戲中的用戶端與伺服器當機。
changes.en: Fixed several client and server crashes during gameplay.

changes.zh: 修正至高附魔師的雷擊重擊與 TNT 爆炸同時發生時的當機。
changes.en: Fixed a crash when The Prime Enchanter's Lightning Slam hit at the same moment as a TNT explosion.

changes.zh: 修正離開線上遊戲時的當機。
changes.en: Fixed a crash when leaving an online game.

changes.zh: 修正以 Ultra 畫質啟動遊戲時畫面模糊。
changes.en: Fixed blurry visuals when the game was started with Ultra graphics quality.

changes.zh: Steam Deck 可以遊玩（部分支援，完整驗證將在之後的更新）。
changes.en: The game is playable on Steam Deck (partial support; full verification is planned for a later update).

changes.zh: 綠寶石上限從 9,999 提高到 99,999（伺服器端調整，所有平台適用）。
changes.en: The emerald cap went up from 9,999 to 99,999 (a server-side change, so on every platform).

changes.zh: Minecraft Dungeons II 正式推出。
